input.message:
Went through all 37 in the LLC take-over project. My call is on every issue and they're all moved. Plan sheet (in my Drive, laid out like your draft, shared with you and Blake): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1DuRVhc5sLkGn4BRUnxbQeQBzcPgWYpMoik5FOXuuiWo/edit

**What I'd do**
• **Combo Fighter only.** The LLC buys it through Sunset's sale if no one else does. I'll move it when the sale closes.
• **DD and ZM stay with HG.** By the warehouse revenue table, DD made $183.11 in January against ~$1k/mo on its prod account (doesn't even cover Blake's $300 target). ZM made $0.
• **LLC takes (Todo):** CF's AWS backend/auth account at $95/mo (Blake moves billing by Mar 1) and AppsFlyer free tier for CF at $0 (you, by Mar 1).
• **Blake pays himself through May (Done):** Metabase $100, dbt $100, GitHub $48 = $248/mo.
• **Everything else stays with HG (Canceled):** the #winddown keeps/cancels, the DD/ZM accounts, build machines, Figma (prepaid to Sep 11), Unity Pro (CF is fine on Personal). I also left out one-offs and yearly fees (playable vendor, Apple/Google dev accounts), and Calm Play, since the LLC is the new one you two are setting up.

**What it costs each of us a month (Mar-May)**
Total is $343/mo, so a third each is **$114.33/mo**.
• Me: $114.33 cash
• You: $114.33 cash
• Blake: his $248 already counts toward his third, so he puts in nothing and the LLC pays him back $133.67/mo

Talk Monday.
